name: dnbg-workflow
description: Opinionated GitHub workflow: worktree + draft PR flow, self-documenting issues, and an independent PR reviewer bot.

owners.title: GitHub owners this workflow applies to
owners.description: Comma-separated list of GitHub orgs and/or personal logins, e.g. 'acme-corp,yourname'. A repo is covered when its origin remote points at one of them. Leave empty and the enforcement hooks never block anything — the skills still load as guidance.

worktree_path.title: Where worktrees live
worktree_path.description: Repo-relative directory the workflow creates worktrees in, e.g. 'wt' or '.git/wt'. Must stay inside the repo and be a plain path: absolute paths, '~' paths, any '..' segment, a leading '-', and characters outside letters, digits and '. _ - /' are rejected and the default used instead. Leave empty for '.worktrees'.

claim_label.title: Issue claim label
claim_label.description: Label applied when an agent session claims a GitHub issue. Must start with 'assigned:' — the check for someone else's claim matches that whole namespace, so a label outside it makes your claims invisible to other tools and theirs invisible to you. Leave empty for 'assigned:agent-session'.
